No component nominated for condition. The Issue 212 singular-model example experiment uses the
rna layer to assess the declared condition target contrasts treatment with control. (A)
Component PC1 shows individual observations; no population trajectory or interaction interval
is estimable. (B) Component PC2 shows individual observations; no population trajectory or
interaction interval is estimable. Thin lines connect repeated observations from each subject.
The analysis unit is complete subject trajectory; the design is longitudinal; the estimand is
condition-by-time interaction on the rank scale; time is recorded as day; subjects are
identified by mouse_id. No interaction interval or resampling recurrence is available. Raw
p-values are retained; q-values use Holm correction across declared components within each
metadata field and evidence variant. No acceptance threshold is applied. No unique biological
coordinate is identified.
